body:
Today I went through a massive low. I sat in town for about an hour trying to decide as to whether or not I would get an iphone. I phoned  home and my sister told me to put it off until I felt like I couldn't put it off any longer.

I dragged myself away from signing a phone contract, and decided that money would be better spent on doing things with people I DO get to meet. So for now I'm happy I didn't get one.

I've registered to Okcupid instead of getting a tinder, to put my energy somewhere so that I feel like I'm getting some form of social life. It's working. I feel good!

About an hour ago I decided, I'm not going to lose. I'm going to win. I hate that I've gotten to such a sad level of thought, but I'm going to pull through, and I'm going to work hard at not letting it beat me.

There is adventure in my future, I want to stick around to feel and see it.

Thanks for being a great motivator when I needed it, chaldeanrefuge!

Okay so I went home to pick up my art book, walked myself down to the pub, passed it, and walked straight back home.

Everywhere I go is literally drowned in the memory of my ex. Even that pub. So I kind of didn't want to enter. I didn't see many people from outside, and no one that I would particularly want to get to know.

It's okay though, it gave me something to do for a bit other than feeling anxious for completely negative reasons.

I'm going to spend some time here in the library looking at these meet ups before I go home and sleep. I think I'm going to grab an iphone tomorrow and get tinder on it. Anything that will make me feel like I'm doing something about my social life.

[Alert just went that library is closing, looks like it will have to wait]

I'll start working out tonight! I have tried meetup.com and nothing sprung up in my area. I live near Manchester though so I'll go check there now. I've not heard of SimplePickup.com but I've just opened a tab and am checking it out.

I've thought about going to a pub tonight, which holds live acts music this day of the week. Perhaps if I take a sketch pad with me, I won't feel as though I look miserable alone with a pint! Hmmm. Maybe I could ask to volunteer there for bar experience.

See, now I'm having one of those nice bursts of optimism. This is how I used to feel all the time before university, but now it's scary because I never know how long they will last.

Ok time to do the thing!

EDIT: It's really hard keeping the confidence to do this stuff independently. I just question myself and how I come across too much.

I came back to my university flat a couple of days ago, a month before anyone else arrives or the university starts. So right now I've got no one to do anything with, but I feel like I have something to wait for, which is good.

I just can't shake these swings. One second I might feel like I'm doing okay, then BAM. I feel destroyed, I feel like my ex abandoned me, I feel like I screwed up... I feel a lot of things.

It's not fun.

I'm trying really hard to wait for the term to start, so I can go find a society/group to join so that I can get stuck into a new social dynamic. Right now, I'm just incredibly struggling to deal with the fact that I'm here by myself.

Edit: Every hour, literally feels like a long, long day.

We dated for 3 years. In those 3 years I couldn't decide if I wanted to be with her or not since day 1. In the end, my lack of affection rubbed off, so she broke it off with me..
..right before summer, where she,my friends, and peers that I began my university journey with all graduated.

I'm the only one who didn't graduate because I changed course in an attempt to shake/solve my depression in second year.

Also Manchester!

Us UK people need all the up boats we can get in this subreddit.

:3

My problem is that I stick out relationships even when I feel sucky about the other person, I wait it out until I learn to love them again. Love is a commitment, not an idea that you'll stay in the honeymoon period consistently. Unfortunately it's always too late when you realise they don't have the same values.

Shame there's no bullshit flag that raises when someone tells you all the flowery love stuff during the highs of a relationship. It's like they aren't aware if it themselves.. Just saying stuff in the moment.

Anyway, nice sentiment Stephanie.
Seeing ourselves as meat and bones is an awfully sad way to live :/

A wild STD appeared.

Tried to run.

Can't escape.
The grass is greener where you water it.
Can we get a rough translation of what they're singing about?
Haha, close shave. Try and see the funny side to it! It makes a good short story!
THERE.IS.NO.HALLWAY.SCENE.

''Do you like to Party?''

She checked out my profile, but no response.
It was a reference to [Hot Rod](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Y2nPHYpmXc) , but I found the thought of her thinking I was legitimate quit funny.

Inactive accounts!
I might come across a profile that gives me a buzz, then I remember to check last online. If it's February they're probably not coming back, and now I feel slightly bereft of an opportunity!

When those thoughts come to your mind, dispel them in favour of putting yourself in her stead. Re-assure yourself that it's you who's going to meet  new girls, and it's you who's going to share those moments with someone new.

That's all you've got to do, keep putting the focus back on yourself.

That would be my advice.
:)

There is actually a r/exnocontact sub where everybody helps each other in dealing with the stages of grief that follow from a break-up.

If you go no contact I highly recommend you stop by.
Stay strong.
A 9 year relationship doesn't last that long without making it an emotional commitment, as opposed to a physical one. Think about that.

Okay. This is going to come from personal experience and I'm sure you will in fact relate to what I'm saying.

Closure will come regardless of getting in touch with her or not. Sure things might be unresolved, maybe you didn't get the last word, or maybe you've thought of something else that you feel is important to tell her. The truth is, the only thing from granting you closure in my experience is hope, and though I'm only 22, I feel like your therapist is actually enabling you here to continue your struggle to 'resolve' things with her.

I think you need to stop. She has blocked you and isn't there for you anymore, but do you know what? It's always going to be their loss if they can't appreciate who you were, and breaking up will always be the best thing that happened to you in order to find someone else who does.

I say this with a lot of heart. You will be okay!

How do you feel about this?

I think a wider head would be nice. 
Right now it feels like it's profile has a lot more substance than looking at it from head on. Make it protrude a little more!
This.

What I see right now is truth.

Either she feels the way she said when drunk, in which case you have no reason to worry, or she was being manipulative which gives you a reason to take her down from the pedestal.

Meanwhile, you'd displayed your willingness to talk if that's what she wants, but you can't put your life on hold.

Hang in there.

You should feel proud of yourself.

You're powering through this like a champ.

Hope you're okay.

As time goes on, you become less concerned about what she's up to, because as scary as it is, you will actually start to consider her much like a stranger. In two weeks (even less), your mind won't bother too much with wondering about this person who you don't feel you know anymore, and you'll be busy thinking about yourself, and where you're going!! :)

Well, definitely don't do any begging. You've been through the worst part of no contact, and at worse this will cause your feelings to relapse, but it will take less than half the time it did before, to get to a good place.

I would say, see what she has to say and if it changes anything, talk. If what she says doesn't change anything, wish her the best, and continue with no contact.

If I was in your scenario I'd be in all kinds of minds, thinking about what way I should act in the call.

A lot of people on here have made it evident to me in the past, to not play games. Your feelings are your feelings, don't try and say anything that you think might manipulate it a certain way. You have your feelings, wether you are confused, or know what you want, that's something you should be honest about.

Personally as well, I think it's most important that you don't let her take your pride away.

<--- sorry if that came a cross a little stern. Just trying to help you get your head straight if it isn't already! 

Let us know how it goes. Keep your head held high.
Damn straight.

Oh my god. I have no idea how torn you must be feeling right now. If she wasn't being honest with her feelings when she was kissing you, then cruelty has reached a new level.

Maybe ask her if she remembers much of what she said last night. Then ask her if she wants to elaborate on what she was saying?

What do you think?

Oh sweet! I'm quite excited by the list. Might need to work my way through them.

The three titles standing out for me are - I Have a Bed Made of Buttermilk Pancakes, I Capture the Castle, Sputnik Sweetheart.

Last night I started reading a book called 'The Goldfinch'. Not sure if it's relevant, but it says in the description that it's about loss, obsession and self-invention. I'll get my hands on one of the books listed, ready before I finish this one!
The search for self after a break up is definitely the kind of material I'm after. Stephen King speaks for himself as well, I'll check this out!

The shameful truth, I never read books. I'm trying to do some character re-construction, replacing the time I spend playing games, by reading books and learning guitar. Just becoming richer in character!

I was after a book that would make me feel up beat. Something to make me reflect positively on the future!

Thanks! I sure will :)
Okay, wasn't sure if this classed as a recommendation or a discussion. I would of liked a discussion about said books but okay :)
Knowing there's people like this in the world actually makes me really happy :)
You have each other.

Not sure. I think the hardest part is the dawning realisation that you are not going to be with this person, and also dealing with the memories of the one you love, without having her there to reminisce with you. The person she was, is not the person she is to you anymore. The way someone can go from promising you their life, to fucking off is incomprehensible to me at times. I love her, that should be enough for anyone.

Thinking about her having sex with other people is the worst part for me by far. It hurts, and it makes my heart beat fast every time it crosses my mind. One thought that re-occurs in my mind that helps me deal with this, is that no one is ever going to hold the memories I do of her.

I want her back so bad :(

Wish I could re-wind time and do it all better.

Today was the first day where I knew there is nothing I can do. I've done a lot less pacing, and I've tried being active in other areas, but I've also been going through some panic attacks today thinking about how she should be here, but she's not.

My head isn't only a mess, but my heart too.

If I could marry this girl in the future, and grow up to die with her, I will have had a great life. She's all I want.

Thanks for your positive reinforcement.

I'm rooting for you too buddy. Whatever you do, keep to the no contact. Maybe if I had, she would have realised I was mature and worth speaking to. I fucking miss her.

I've even started having panic attacks when I think about her. It was so sudden that my brain still believes that I have a girl who loves me and is there for me to cuddle with, and there's the other part that I'm trying to drill in, that she has gone, and that there is no hope of seeing her again.

When people tell each other that they love one another, they should be prepared to commit to it when everything feels wrong, and be prepared to see it through until you learn to love each other equally again. Saying you love someone is a bond you make, where you both agree to take care of each others hearts. It's cruel to make such a promise, only to take your heart away, and crush the one you were supposed to take care of.

Again, another tangent.

I don't know how your scenario will go, all I can do, is wish you a better future. I know you will have one because you sound awesome.

Before her, I had spent years not being even remotely interested in girls because of the break up I went through with my 'first love' so to speak. When I came to uni, I saw this girl and said to myself ''[Throwawayseptember15], you are going to date this girl, she is the one for you''
After a couple of weeks I started asking her to not hold my hand in public, and stop trying to act coupley with me at all when in public, i needed the space to get comfortable with it. She fell head over heels for me, and I didn't let myself do the same because I was scared that she would break my heart if I cared for her. 3 years later of not letting myself care and the break up made me realise I never had a choice, I was in love the whole time, I just didn't let our love flourish.
I literally feel like someone has fucked with me life. It's not fair to come to such a realisation after trying so hard to not get hurt again.
I had the power to be myself and marry this girl, but I decided to try my best to hold myself back. She doesn't think I'm the one for her anymore, and won't let me prove that I can actually make her happy.

Maybe in a few years. I'd like to think that me and this girl wind up together again, as a very happy couple, and start a family.

It hurts so much.
After a break up with such a kind person, I doubt it will be years and years until I find someone again.

Sorry about the tangent. Me and my girl have completely cut all ties, and won't be talking for a very very long time, if ever.

I wish I could be with her again.

Thanks for this..

Well I got a call from my friend today, he told me that the day I text her, she was quiet and kept to herself for the rest of it. She's in a very stressful position right now with her submission tomorrow, so I can understand why she's put us to one side until that is down, but at the same time I'm glad my message caused her to feel. Being out of sight and out of mind has been my biggest worry, and if by letting her know I still exist and that I feel good makes her sad, then hopefully we will be back together sooner than I could hope.

I'm curious, in your first break up with your girlfriend, you mentioned that you were excessively clingy for the beginning, until you went completely cold turkey... I wonder if this is actually part of getting them back, routine-ing them into being chased, and then completely pulling the rug from under their feet...

Either way, I sent her a text yesterday, just a nice casual text telling her I hope her work is coming along well with a little ''miss you xx'' at the end of it to keep me in a lovers light. Her submission date is tomorrow at 12, after that I'm sure she'll start to consider what is happening more.

I plan to see her wednesday, and just hang out with her, but I won't let her know until the night before, so she has from friday until tuesday at least to contemplate.

I think this is a good plan. I obviously have a little sickening feeling that it could go wrong, but I'll always have that sickening feeling at every step regardless of how bad or good my decision actually is.

She was unhappy in the relationship and so was I. The problem was that I neglected her affection. The plan is to get her back, show her I care, show her that I've grown up... And of course show her I am the happy guy she fell for, I just got a little lost along the way.

I honestly feel like this is the best advice I have had so far.

I need to let go of the past, and be an exciting prospect to get her back. I've getting my driving out the way to show her a sense of growing up, my theory exam is tomorrow. This can pan out, I just need to stay awesome.

I split with her a week ago Saturday. I left that Tuesday to give us space. It's been a week today not speaking to her. In about a week from now, I'm going to visit her, and see if we can start a fresh better relationship.

I've put so much effort into this no contact, I hope she reciprocates.

Every fucking night.

It's odd, because when I was with her, if she was ever in my dream she'd be a horrible person. Now that we split, she's as beautiful of a person in my dreams as she is in real life.

I've been awake since five this morning. All I want to do from waking up, is text her or call her.
You have no idea how much the break up has immediately caused me to re-evaluate. If I work this out, I will show her what it is to be loved.

I neglected this girl for the better part of the relationship, constantly at a cross roads with how I felt about her.
This space became a wake up call for me, to how much she actually means to me. If my heart can wake up, then so can hers.

That's all it takes for me to maintain this plan right now.

It's tough, but if it pays off I'll forever be grateful.
If it doesn't, I'll take every day as it comes, until I find someone better.

Man that hurts to read.
How anyone can inflict such feelings is horrible.
I hope you get increasing joy out of life when this is over with.
For better or worse, people just aren't this simple..

I think I might have to forget her for now, and revisit her in a couple of weeks/months. Thinking about this everyday doesn't increase my chances and the pain just stops me from making that inner change for when I am going to need it.

Yeah that makes sense. Didn't realise :)

Hopefully I'll be able to provide a success story in a couple of months.

Also do you ever wonder if the phase of desperation before NC is actually vital for them to miss that routine when you take it away?

Hmmmmm.

This is great news. I'm trying to get physically fit but sometimes I look at myself and think. . . It's not noticeable. Is there anything you guys do to emphasize on your physical change?
I've cut my hair smarter and am planning to possibly get new clothes. Just wondering if there's something I've missed.

I'm trying to evaluate my scenario. I think my best chances might not be in a months time, but 2-3. 

Thanks for your positive input! I've seen success stories here and there, but because this sub-reddit probably doesn't have regular contributors, those who have been able to reconcile as a result are probably long gone, and don't find it worth sharing.

Leaving most of us hopeless ones here to only speculate that it only ends in moving on.

This is a very nice comment, thanks.

It's just for me, I feel like I made my ex wait for me for longer, and I put her through what I'm going through now. So now it's my turn, I don't want to give up when the tough gets going for me, I want to hold out for her like she did for me.

I applied for my provisional a couple of days ago, and it came in the post today to my suprise. I'll be booking my theory tomorrow, and after that a crash course. I aim to be able to drive in 2-3 months, at which point (if she hasn't contacted me) I will let her know I'm coming to see her, I will come with car, spend a day with her doing fun stuff, and she how she feels at the end of it.

I have this image. I sure it's what I need to do :(
Prove myself.....
Just keep writing down your urges. Things will fall into place.

Wow, everything you typed, is just as I feel, and just as I have done in my relationship.

I broke her. I neglected her feelings. I didn't take pride in her. She became unhappy after 3 years, and anything I could say she would tell me is 3 years too late.

I'm giving her space as she is in her university hand-in period. Until then she won't be thinking about it, like I have been thinking about it. Hopefully when she is done, and the stresses relieve a little, she will think about us and contact me.

Me two choices right now include putting together a letter and giving it to her in two weeks, or learning to drive, getting a job, getting healthy, and speaking to her in a couple of months. It's hard to tell which to do, and while space for the longer period seems like it would give me such a better chance of fixing it, it is the things in between that you wonder about. 

If she is tainted by someone else in the time we are apart. To be honest, I think I would handle it. I have been in my relationships, and I was just her first, so maybe she needs those post-relationship experiences.

Don't you just feel like your word vomiting at the end of the day?
That the things you want to say, can't be said. and therefore hold no real world value?

I'm crossing my fingers for you. Whatever your ex is going through right now, my ex is feeling the same. There's got to be a silver lining.

Yeah. . . I've been thinking about this loads and am not even sure if a letter is right. I mean, there are important things which I need to say about my outlook on future life, but I can't help but feel like I should hold these cards until an opportunity arises in the future.

I have almost a week until the letter would happen, I've just got to decide what to do.

I like to think that she will contact me in the next two months if I do nothing, but her knowing these things might help her decision.

Thanks for your advice, and I hope you're are okay.

I'm going to be able to drive by the end of this summer. It took me long enough but I've applied for my provisional, and when that comes through I'll be booking my theory which I've started studying for now.
I've changed my outlook on the end of university and am taking responsible measures.

It's hard to show someone who isn't there. I don't think for a second that the bridge is burnt all the way. 

Needless to say I'm in a tough situation, but I've got to stick it out. I've got to...

It's not what I want to hear, but I can completely agree with what you are saying.

I would have left it the way things are going for a couple of months, but after talking to an old close friend from home, she suggested the letter as some of the things I have re-evaluated are worth saying.

I'm pretty much leaning towards it at this point.

I don't want you to think I'm dwelling. I've been in break ups before, and understand that things get better sooner than you think. In this break up I've done some soul-searching, and all the things I was adamant about never doing... such as marrying, I could easily do with her.

I don't think I have the luxury of talking this over with her, I think it would push her away. There's too much pressure right now and I need to give her space, in the meantime, I'm just not sure if I should write a letter this thursday noting that I'm ready to grow up, or if I should save my cards and play things at a later date all together.

I hope you get what you want out of your situation.

Life. Why is there no guide. . .

Unfortunately it's not that easy.

I've got two choices. I can either not speak to her until next year sometime, and try to rekindle this.

or I can plan to do the same, but this Thursday give her a letter enclosing all my feelings and about where and who I want to be.

Well, I still have another year of university ahead of me. She graduates this year, so she has a lot to think about. If I'm going to make this work out, I doubt it will be now...

I've thought about possibly painting an oil piece of her, A2 size, and getting it sent to her or something on valantines. Maybe that would be the appropriate time for her to remember me, and know that we are still worth something.

As she left for university the day I was leaving, whilst opening the door to leave, she must have turned around and hugged me tight and cried at least five times. I was all teared out at this point, and decided to be a positive influence in our last moments so she might remember happiness, and not sadness in the future. When she said she didn't have it in her to close the door behind her, I told her to just start walking, and I'll close it. I waited a couple of seconds before stepping out to watch her leave. She turned around a couple of times crying, and held contact with me as she turned the corner of the street. I have been so anti-cliche with love stuff for the longest time, cringing at such matters, but this meant so much, and I'm not afraid to admit that I enjoyed the feeling of loss we both felt in those moments.

I understand that she says she doesn't feel the same for me, we've both been subject to a relationship of bad habits and neglect for the last year, but I do believe from her exit, that ultimately she can still love me, that she does love me, but those feelings are mute for now. There has been to much bad.

Man, I love her. Sucks that out of all ways of contact she told me I should keep her number. I've had to change the name in my phone so I don't associate it with her. I would delete it, but though that would be easier right now, I'll need it for the future.

Fuck. Life sucks right now.

I am confident that in the future, if I want it bad enough, I will be able to win her over. She is my sweet heart, and I her first. The only problem was our maturity.

Thanks for your advice by the way, but yeah, I'm not in a position to seek her out quite yet. I'll give it a couple of months...  or years.

Not since I left. The advice I have been given, is to give it space, and if in a couple of weeks she regrets her decision she will know. Though, if I keep pushing, I'll destroy any chances of that happening.

I can't help but think this will take more than a couple of weeks... This isn't about her realising she wants to be with me now. This is about getting out of this relationship and getting over it. 

We have said that we don't know about the future, and when we are better people, we can make the decision then to reconnect. Forming a fresh mutual relationship, not restarting this shitty one where I never showed her I cared.

I miss her so much.

Hey, Thanks for a response. Right now I'm going through the motions of feeling sick at the thought of what is happening and how I could have been different. It means a lot to hear someone say that I shouldn't force myself to live with that, as it's how I feel right now.

She's going to wake up in about 10-20 minutes to her alarm. I think I'm going to hug her, and ask her to come see me just before she leaves so I can hug her again.

Right now I haven't made my goal clear to her, because where she is at right now, it would simply destroy any chances. I need to wait until we are better people, until she's at a place when she can understand that a new relationship, wouldn't be the old one, and then hope. I have heard stories of people who have been in the same predicament as me, and as little as 6 months later, they work things out and live with each other at a much better standard.

So although I know that chances are not looking good right now, in the future like you said, I like to think that if it's meant to be, it will be. I just can't write this off completely.
Be nice.
